issues: 浅灰平底 + 一个居中的小号「IMPACT」，主体只占画面一条，前 20 帧是空白死帧
两版是黑 + 灰，叠出来读作投影或重影，没有一点印刷油墨的感觉
错位幅度相对字号太小，撞停和套准两拍都不够有力，套准后没有任何收束
版面只有一条细线，整帧不是一张设计过的海报
changes: 配色 custom：再生新闻纸 + riso 荧光粉 × 蓝两色油墨，两版 multiply 套准时叠成深紫，错开时一侧粉一侧蓝的彩边
版式重做成瑞士网格演出海报：300px 黑体两行「PRINT IT / LOUD.」压在右侧一只粉版半调网点大太阳上（点径随离心距离收到 0），顶部版记与通栏线、底部三栏演出信息（蓝版）
开场不再空等：太阳像被墨辊自上而下滚上纸（0–16f 硬边擦入），版线展开、信息栏错峰升起；20–28f 标题 ease-in 撞入带方向性模糊
错位加到单版 20/8px（总分离约 40px），命中同帧整页 1.2% 顿挫；72f 硬切套准 + 4f scale 脉冲，同帧盖下一枚「ON REGISTER」圆章作为收束
尾段 44f 干净 hold，相机按 smooth 曲线极缓推进 1.2%
issuesEn: Flat light grey with a small centred "IMPACT": the subject was a thin strip, and the first 20 frames were dead blank frames
The two plates were black and grey, which read as a drop shadow or ghosting, not printing ink
The offset was small relative to the type size, so neither the hit nor the snap into register landed, and nothing marked the resolve
A single hairline was the whole layout; no frame looked like a designed poster
changesEn: Custom palette: recycled newsprint with fluorescent pink and blue riso inks; multiplied in register they make deep violet, and out of register they leave a pink fringe on one side and blue on the other

Rebuilt as a Swiss-grid gig poster: a two-line 300px "PRINT IT / LOUD." over a big pink halftone sun on the right (dot size shrinking to zero at the rim), a masthead with full-width rule, and three columns of event info in the blue plate

No more empty wait: the sun is rolled onto the paper top-down like an ink roller (hard-edged wipe, 0–16f), rules extend and info columns rise in a stagger; 20–28f the headline slams in with ease-in and directional motion blur

Offset raised to 20/8px per plate (about 40px total), with a 1.2% whole-page jolt on the hit frame; at 72f a hard cut into register plus a 4f scale pulse, and an "ON REGISTER" round stamp lands on the same frame as the resolve
A clean 44f tail hold with a very slow 1.2% smooth camera push
